description: DRAFT (scripts/block-face/draft-type.ts (src/canalRecall/blockFace/typeDraft.ts)) for the review turn. Frederik Hendrikbuurt-Zuidoost family 1885-1889, 5 storeys, <4.9 m wide: 57 pands on 4 block faces; median cornice 13.69 m, 3 window columns, wall #64584e. Pane layout, head kind, cornice kind, crowns and ground variants are NOT measured: see draft.unmeasured.

notes: DRAFTER VERDICT: LOW CONFIDENCE. The houweningen-2-38 strip (2021-03-22) shows the street over its bottom quarter: the strip's ground line is well under the facade foot, so storey lines and eaves measured from it are offset (run the stripFoot.ts foot offset before trusting storeyHeights). Window columns, palette and widths are not affected.
Draft, not installed. Medians over 57 pands; refused below 8 pands or 3 faces.
